title.narrative: Reverse Trade Mission - Power Sector, through CORE International, Inc.

description.narrative: This reverse trade mission aimed to support the implementation of the $350 million, five-year Millennium Challenge Corporation compact agreement with the Government of Malawi, foster the implementation of electric power projects in Malawi that will build upon the compact, and facilitate the participation of U.S. companies in Malawi's electric power sector.

person-name.narrative: Amy Swers and Liz Sutton; Ryan Boles

title.narrative: Technical Assistance - Golomoti Solar Power Project, through Power Engineers, Inc.

description.narrative: A USTDA grant to Golomoti JCM Solar Corporation partially funds a feasibility study (Study) to assess the viability of a 17.5 to 40 MW solar power project in the Golomoti district of Malawi (Project). The Study will determine the size of the solar facility and whether an energy storage system is appropriate for co-location on the Project site. The implementation of the project will result in an increase in and diversification of electricity generation in Malawi, a country with one of the world's lowest electrification rates.

title.narrative: Feasibility Study - Mzuzu Wind and Battery Storage Feasibility Study, through Enterprise - United States Unknown

description.narrative: This grant funds a feasibility study for Mzuzu WF Limited that will assess the viability of a 50-megawatt wind energy project and a 100 megawatt-hour battery energy storage system near the city of Mzuzu in the northern region of Malawi. It will be one of the country's first utility-scale wind energy generation facilities and will significantly augment the country's current generation capacity of 442 MW while helping stabilize the national energy grid and enhance resilience to climate change.
